dct_description_sm:
Building Permits show active building permits in the last three years, and closed permits for the last year and half within the City of Kingston. It is intended to provide an overview of each application.

 

A building permit regulates the type of construction allowed in the community and helps to ensure building standards are met. The building permit process protects customer interests, as well as those of the community and helps to ensure that construction is safe, legal and meets the Ontario Building Code.

 

For more information, please contact the Planning Building and Licensing Department at 1211 John Counter Boulevard, Phone: 613-546-4291 ext. 3260.
